messages.body:
You are working on GitHub issue #88: "[P2][task] Remove channel-specific leaks from core package"

## Issue Details
Core package violates plugin isolation with channel-specific code:

### 1. Instance DB Schema (packages/db/src/schema.ts)
The instances table has 16+ channel-specific columns hardcoded:
- WhatsApp: sessionPath, sessionIdPrefix
- Discord: discordBotToken, discordClientId, discordGuildIds, discordDefaultChannelId, discordVoiceEnabled, discordSlashCommandsEnabled, discordWebhookUrl, discordPermissions, guildConfigOverrides, discordPresence
- Slack: slackBotToken, slackAppToken, slackSigningSecret, slackTeamId
- Telegram: telegramBotToken, telegramReactionLevel

Every new channel requires a schema migration. This doesnt scale.

### 2. Baileys Logger Adapter (packages/core/src/logger/adapters/baileys.ts)
WhatsApp-specific logger adapter in @omni/core. Should be in channel-whatsapp (see also #90).

### Current State (mostly done)
PR #158 removed dead buildSubject, but Baileys adapter still in core. Channel-specific DB columns remain.

### Fix Options for Schema
A) JSONB channelConfig column (flexible but less type-safe)
B) Separate channel_configs table with instanceId + key + value
C) Per-channel config tables (most normalized but most work)

### Acceptance Criteria
- No channel-prefixed columns in instances table
- Channel config accessible via a generic mechanism
- Baileys logger moved to channel-whatsapp
- Existing API endpoints still work (migration path)
- make check green

## YOUR TASK
1. First run /council to analyze this issue — get architectural review and recommendations on which schema approach to take
2. Then run /wish to generate a structured wish plan file with scope, acceptance criteria, and execution groups
3. You are DONE when the wish file is written to disk
